judged_text: The webhook payload field destinationCalendar changes shape from a single DestinationCalendar object (or null) to an array, as the updated expectation `destinationCalendar: []` proves. Every existing webhook subscriber reading `payload.destinationCalendar.externalId` or null-checking the field breaks silently on deploy: property accesses return undefined and `if (destinationCalendar)` becomes truthy for the empty array, with no payload version bump or consumer migration path.

record.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The webhook payload field destinationCalendar changes shape from a single DestinationCalendar object (or null) to an array, as the updated expectation `destinationCalendar: []` proves. Every existing webhook subscriber reading `payload.destinationCalendar.externalId` or null-checking the field breaks silently on deploy: property accesses return undefined and `if (destinationCalendar)` becomes truthy for the empty array, with no payload version bump or consumer migration path.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from `DestinationCalendar | null` to `DestinationCalendar[] | null` (e.g. `packages/types/Calendar.d.ts`, `packages/core/builders/CalendarEvent/class.ts`) and updates webhook test expectations from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (`apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts`). Multiple event payload builders now emit arrays, often `[]` when absent (e.g. `apps/web/pages/api/cron/bookingReminder.ts`, `packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts`). This is a backward-incompatible webhook payload shape change with no evidence in the diff of a version bump or compatibility layer for existing subscribers that expect an object/null.
